x-card.description: Tables and GoogleSQL or PostgreSQL queries in read-only transactions. Changes wait for approval.

project.title: Project
project.description: The Google Cloud project of the Spanner instance.

instance.title: Instance
instance.description: The instance id, as gcloud spanner instances list shows it, not its display name.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database agents use. GoogleSQL and PostgreSQL-dialect databases both work.

source.title: Authentication
source.description: Existing Google sign-in uses Application Default Credentials (ADC) on this computer, from gcloud auth application-default login. A service account key signs in as that service account.

impersonate.title: Service account to impersonate
impersonate.description: Recommended for stage and prod: calls borrow this service account's token for a few minutes. Grant it roles/spanner.databaseReader on the database. Empty: calls use the sign-in or key itself.

delegates.title: Delegation chain
delegates.description: Service accounts that pass the impersonation along, in order, as the IAM API names them. Usually empty.

lifetimeSeconds.title: Token lifetime
lifetimeSeconds.description: How long a borrowed token of the service account to impersonate lasts.

quotaProject.title: Billed project
quotaProject.description: The project whose API quota the calls use (x-goog-user-project); needs serviceusage.services.use. Empty: the credentials' own.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Fine-grained access control. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

databaseRole.title: Database role
databaseRole.description: A fine-grained access control role whose privileges every session gets, instead of the credentials' IAM access to the whole database. The credentials need roles/spanner.fineGrainedAccessUser and access to the role.
